      "snippet": "Good catch. This is not a Termux permissions issue and not a zip issue.
It’s a bash parsing error, and the screenshot gives us enough to diagnose it exactly.

What the error actually means
pgsqlCopy codeline 19: Frameworks,: command not found

That tells us bash is trying to execute the word Frameworks, as a command.
That only happens when bash thinks it’s reading executable text instead of data.
Root cause (precise)
This line in the script is being parsed incorrectly by Android / Termux bash:
